narrative.northStar: A vivid SHIFT Camp welcome that gives campers and families a clear next step.
narrative.overview: The original violet identity returns with a user-selectable light theme. A bold three-line headline, candid photography, camp date, and registration routes lead the experience.

rules.name: The Fast Hero Rule
rules.body: Show hero content on first paint; never use a loader to wait for an entrance animation.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Respect reduced-motion preferences and keep all text and controls available.

dos: Follow system appearance on first visit and persist explicit visitor choice.
Keep the camp date and registration path easy to find.
Use camp photos supplied for the slideshow.
donts: Don't delay or hide the initial hero behind animation.
Don't invent camp logistics that have not been confirmed.
